name: Parchment Light
description: A warm, printed-page look: paper surfaces, near-square rules, and ink-brown accents. Does not follow the operating system's light/dark setting.
_note: Only what differs from Classic is listed. Knowing its own light surfaces, this preset can take the tints darker than Classic's both-themes compromise allows — every one clears WCAG AA for normal text here, not just for bold.
_metrics: Near-square corners and hairline rules, so the blocks read as ruled boxes on a page rather than as cards.
_assets: The flat-colour die, for the same reason the corners are square: on a printed page the artwork is ink, not a rendered object. The pips are the medallion set, whose reds sit in the same warm band as the accents.
